description: Rust-native Minecraft world storage: content-addressed section dedup + zstd container. v0.9.55 THE WORST CASE: the -90% claim no longer rests on untouched chunks - the worst_case_probe stores ALL 262144 chunks through the normal pipeline (phase A pristine OFF, phase B pristine lifecycle fully colonized, 0 pristine remain), every stored chunk verified semantically (bad=0). v0.9.56 THE PACK SWEEP: the first CI run caught the probe's maintenance pass being too weak at bulk scale; the sweep re-raises request_pack before every compact_step until no hot material remains - the shipped container converges to the same per-chunk weight at every scale (240 B/chunk pure codec, 302 B/chunk fully colonized). v0.9.57 THE GATE CAUGHT THE CORPUS: the CI worst-case run measured 262141 stored after 262144 live edits - 3 chunks survived as contracts. The worst_diag forensic replay isolated it: not a race - the documented identical-re-save canon skip fired exactly 3 times, because round-reseeded wgen heights are QUANTIZED and in flat zones land on the same integer height in all 256 columns (measured across the side-16 world: 188829 chunks differ in all columns, ~100 differ in a few, EXACTLY 3 - (158,372), (360,164), (375,463) - differ in ZERO columns; their 'edit' was canonically equal to the seed). The gate was right, the corpus was wrong: the fix makes the player edit constructive - every round>0 chunk has its corner block broken, so round-1 is canonically visible in EVERY chunk by construction. Post-fix replay: skip branch 0 hits, 262144 stored, 0 contracted, no survivors; 75/75 tests green.
